en: Dependent on a state that is a cause and is in training (sekkha), there arises a state that is not a cause and is not in training, by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*)... [Under] the root [condition], three; ... up to ... non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a state that is a cause and is beyond training (asekkha), there arises a state that is not a cause and is not beyond training, by way of the root condition... [Under] the root [condition], three; ... up to ... non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training, there arises a state that is not a cause and is neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training, by way of the root condition... [Under] the root [condition], three; ... up to ... non-disappearance, three.
